threshold.title: Cheap Electricity Threshold (p/kWh)
threshold.description: Measured in p/kWh including VAT. Contact Detected means the current price is at or below this threshold; Closed / Contact Not Detected means there is no cheap electricity because it is above the threshold.

updateInterval.title: Update Interval (seconds)
updateInterval.description: How often to check Octopus Energy, in seconds. The minimum is 30 seconds.

tariffCode.title: Tariff Code (optional)
tariffCode.description: Leave blank to discover the current import electricity tariff from your account.
